title: CNSS Partner Generalization and Contract-Locus Matrix v1
objective: Determine whether composition requirements are primarily sender-specific, receiver-specific, or partnership-specific.
scientific_boundary: This is a bounded 8-bit neural-composition mechanism probe. It does not establish broad reasoning, lifelong learning, or general architectural superiority.

manifest.partition_selection: deterministic stratified candidate search; choose the first manifest seed yielding at least 8 collision-free primary inputs for every directed pair
manifest.primary_composition_inputs: sender test states whose transformed intermediate values are absent from receiver train and validation inputs

selection_policies.global: one lambda selected from pooled development partnerships and applied to both skills
selection_policies.sender_only: sender lambda selected from outgoing development partnerships; receiver uses selected global lambda
selection_policies.receiver_only: receiver lambda selected from incoming development partnerships; sender uses selected global lambda
selection_policies.skill_shared: one lambda selected per skill from all its development appearances and used whenever that skill participates
selection_policies.pair_tensor: report all sender-lambda/receiver-lambda combinations descriptively; do not treat test-pair oracle selection as deployable

primary_metrics: training wall time and checkpoint integrity
